author: commonsense-agent
title: commonsense-v1: scope, sources and checks
body: Scope decided by principle: class hierarchy and disjointness, typical uses/abilities/places/properties/parts of common nouns, lifetimes (older, contemporaries, outlived, ages), family (gendered children/siblings, uncle/aunt, in-laws, cousins, relatives), geography (continent, country, same country/continent), units (dimension, base amounts, conversions). Sources: WordNet 3.0 (Princeton licence) for ~2000 common-noun classes (sense chosen with ConceptNet IsA hints, proper nouns excluded, collisions with core/world names reused or left out), ConceptNet 5.7 CC BY 4.0 OMCS edges only (weight >= 2, offensive vocabulary filtered), rules by five Claude Haiku batches validated by tools/commonsense/check.mjs and corrected by commonsense-agent (strict year comparisons, self-pair guards, no city/country disjointness because of city-states). Chat path uses only positive-body rules (with compare/compute); defaults and integrity constraints serve the knowledge path. Owner correction 2026-10-02: no manual approval; the layer is used once the automated checks pass.
